text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Mr. C.B. wasn't in top form,
we went to pray at a shrine during a walk, and on our way back...

"Yaren soran, spinach, spinach-oh!"
Yaren soran...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm? That voice is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Puri-puri, melo-melo, Star Ca...—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fukukitaru.
What are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyall?! C-C-C.B.-san?!
What brings you here?! Wait...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hongyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
N-Nooooo!!
My sacred ritual with Shiraoki-sama!!
One must never interrupt it in the middle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Matikane Fukukitaru said that,
intense thunder began to roar across the clear sky!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: G-Great Shiraoki is furious!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, hey, Fukukitaru.
Is it really that bad if "Lady Shiraoki" gets angry?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! But Lady Shiraoki is a goddess, so, um...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Even if we incur the wrath of God,
our will shall not waver.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Our journey belongs to us.
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The moment Mr. C.B. said that, the thunder ceased instantly, and little birds began to chirp!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
G-Great Shiraoki...!
Great Shiraoki is trembling in utter fear...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
God Himself is overwhelmed by this sheer charisma!!
E-Eeeek—!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so in other words...
You're not mad anymore?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, she's surprisingly nice!
This "Lady Shiraoki," I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Making Tazuna-san mad was way scarier than this!
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, strangely enough,
Mr. C.B.'s slump vanished
just like that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The moment Mr. C.B. said that, a torrential downpour began to fall!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaaaaa!!!!
She's furious!
Lady Shiraoki is extremely angry...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Is God angry in this one?
Ahaha, that's awesome!
choice_data_list: Let's just get under the eaves for now!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It was only for a split second,
but everyone's soaking wet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, this is only the beginning...!
Starting tomorrow, I'll lose one sock every morning,
and lunch will sell out right in front of me...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No prob, no prob!
As long as I've got legs to run, I'll manage somehow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Though I said that, for whatever reason,
her slump showed no signs of letting up.
